reasoningChain.evidence: Increasing the current damage core before the full four-enemy encounter supports direct progression.
The berserker has repeatedly led or nearly led team damage and currently has no weapon equipped.
The rare physical weapon lists the berserker among its highest-fit users and adds low-health damage plus critical damage.
Equipping the proven berserker adds the full weapon gain without disrupting the successful roster; the new assassin is untested and would require removing a verified contributor.
